headline: Approved fuel storage licenses at 40-50,60 Sylvan Road and 245 Fifth Ave; tabled Rule 95 Resolution.
summary: Councillors approved fuel storage licenses for 40-50,60 Sylvan Road and 245 Fifth Ave. They also approved a request asking the City Clerk to tell utility companies that the council will enforce Rule 95. The Rule 95 Resolution was then tabled.
decisions: Approved the 9/21/2026 minutes by voice vote.
Approved the fuel storage license for ARE-MA Region at 40-50,60 Sylvan Road by voice vote.
Approved the 245 Fifth Ave Fuel Storage license by voice vote.

Approved a request, by voice vote, for the City Clerk to notify utility companies that the council will enforce Rule 95 and to have them send copies of their 2-year master plans to the city Councillors.
Tabled the Rule 95 Resolution by voice vote.

decision_titles: Fuel storage license for ARE-MA Region at 40-50,60 Sylvan Road
plain_text:
Licenses & Franchises Committee
Meeting Minutes
October 5, 2026
The Chair called the meeting to order at 7:30 p.m. 
The Clerk called the roll.
Present: Brasco, Vidal, Logan, and Tzioumis. 
Absent: Katz.
Artie Kronenfeld of The Waltham Times was recording the meeting.
Councillor Tzioumis moved approval of the 9/21/2026 minutes. The motion was approved by a 
voice vote.
First agenda item: Fuel Storage license for ARE-MA Region at 40-50,60 Sylvan Road
Jamie Giordana, representing the petitioner, spoke on the license. They have a tenant. President 
Logan moved approval of the license. The motion was approved by a voice vote.
Councilor Logan moved to take the 245 Fifth Ave Fuel Storage license off the table. The motion 
was approved by a voice vote. Paul Finger, representing the petitioner, spoke on the license. 
Stokes is the new tenant moving in. President Logan moved approval of the license. The motion 
was approved by a voice vote.
Councilor Logan moved to take the Rule 95 Resolution off the table. The motion was approved 
by a voice vote. Councillor Logan made a request that was approved by a voice vote to have the 
City Clerk notify the utility companies that the council will planning to enforce Rule 95 and that 
they send copies of their 2-year master plan to the city Councillors. On the request Councillor 
Tzioumis asked a question. Councillor Logan moved to table the matter. The motion was 
approved by a voice vote.
With no further matters Councillor Brasco moved to adjourn.
Chairman Vidal declared the meeting adjourned at 7:40p.m.
Respectfully submitted,
Kara Wilson, Clerk of the Licenses & Franchises Committee
October 7, 2026
